The '''Ziugen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. The system lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']] that connected it to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and the [[Outland Transit Station]]. A smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also linked the system to the planet of [[Poytta]]. The Ziugen system contained the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] colony world of the [[Ziugen|same name]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ziugen system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square T-12.<ref name="TEA" />
